# Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL) for Third-Party Services

Protecting domain models from external vendor drift: translating third-party schemas into domain aggregates at the integration boundary.

## Invariants
- NEVER_EXPOSE_VENDOR_TYPES_IN_DOMAIN_CORE
- TRANSLATE_ERRORS_TO_INTERNAL_DOMAIN_EXCEPTIONS
- ISOLATE_SDK_IMPORTS_INSIDE_ADAPTERS
